2609.26637.title: Capable yet Parsimonious: Extracting and Characterizing Hidden Chain-of-Thought in Frontier Models
2609.26637.paper_summary: The rapid capability gains of frontier language models are widely attributed to improved reasoning abilities, yet this cannot be verified as raw CoT traces in closed-source systems are hidden. By registering a simple custom tool through a standard API feature, we induce frontier models to externalize intermediate reasoning. Because these traces may reflect post-hoc rationalization rather than genuine reasoning, we first evaluate against native CoT on open-source models and extend to closed-source frontier models including GPT-6 Astra. We find that the extracted reasoning matches native reasoning performance and substantially outperforms no-reasoning baselines, across competition mathematics, science, and code generation. We then characterize how frontier models structure their intermediate reasoning. Across token efficiency, reasoning-step types, and induced reasoning trees, we identify systematic differences in how models externalize, compress, and organize reasoning. We find that Astra exhibits token-efficient directed reasoning, selecting a correct trajectory earlier, while resolving elementary steps internally and externalizing only crucial reasoning. These findings provide a behavioral lens on frontier-model reasoning beyond benchmark scores.
2609.26637.paper_summary_zh: 前沿語言模型的快速能力提升被廣泛歸因於改進的推理能力，然而，由於閉源系統中的原始CoT痕跡被隱藏，這一點無法得到驗證。通過通過標準API功能註冊一個簡單的自定義工具，我們促使前沿模型外部化中間推理。由於這些痕跡可能反映的是事後合理化而非真正的推理，我們首先在開源模型上對原生CoT進行評估，並擴展到包括GPT-6 Astra在內的閉源前沿模型。我們發現，提取的推理與原生推理表現相匹配，並在競爭數學、科學和代碼生成方面大幅超越了無推理基準。我們接著描述了前沿模型如何結構其間接推理。在標記效率、推理步驟類型和誘導推理樹方面，我們識別出模型在外部化、壓縮和組織推理方面的系統性差異。我們發現Astra展現出標記高效的定向推理，較早選擇正確的軌跡，同時在內部解決基本步驟，僅外部化關鍵推理。這些發現提供了一個行為視角，超越基準分數來理解前沿模型的推理。
